draft.stem: A hotel chain sells its owned hotel properties to REITs and signs long-term management/brand franchise agreements, collecting a percentage of room revenue and incentive fees without funding real estate capex. What business-model shift occurred?
options: Shifting to a vertically integrated raw-material mining model
Shifting from an asset-heavy owner-operator model to an asset-light franchising/management-fee model
Adopting a razor-and-blade physical hardware model

perOptionFeedback.0: Incorrect. Selling real estate to focus on brand/management fees is asset-light franchising, not vertical integration.
perOptionFeedback.1: Correct. Asset-light franchising/licensing boosts ROIC and reduces capital intensity while shifting property operating leverage to franchisees.
perOptionFeedback.2: Incorrect. Hotel brand licensing is a fee/franchise model rather than captive consumables.
